_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every published price (NET amounts as decided by the owner). Gross consumer prices, travel fees and calculator values are derived from this file at build time: node tools/build-prices.mjs (js/prices.js + static price markers on the hand-written pages), node tools/build.mjs (generated pages). Do not type prices anywhere else.

vat.note: 21 % is the owner's PLANNING value for consumer (gross) price display. It is NOT a verified tax status: the real rate and invoicing situation must be checked when the Spanish business is finalised (docs/seo/FINAL-OWNER-INPUT-REQUIRED.md, group 1). The owner explicitly instructed (2026-11-28) that consumer prices are shown gross with this rate, therefore the production price gate passes on displayApprovedByOwner. Change ratePercent here and rebuild: every page and the calculator update.

chemical.note: Net price per treatment occasion. A repeat chemical treatment costs the same as the matching first treatment.

drySteamStandalone.note: Net base price from. The final price depends on the on-site conditions, the surfaces involved and the extent of the infestation.

extras._status: approved by the owner (net prices). Dry steam add-on is a FLAT fee per chemical treatment, NOT per bedroom.

steamAddOnToChemical.unit: flat fee per chemical treatment (not per bedroom)

coldFoggingFrom.unit: minimum price (from) - only when technically justified and assessed on site

terms.repeatChemicalTreatment: same price as the matching first treatment; no automatic free second treatment; no approved fixed guarantee package
terms.urgentTreatment: normal price; availability depends on capacity (never a guaranteed same-day slot)
terms.followUpVisit: separate on-site follow-up check: individual agreement
terms.onSiteInspection: part of the ordered treatment (not sold as a stand-alone service)
terms.travel: fixed fee per town and treatment (see travel.towns); town not listed = individual quote

retired: Completo plan (239/289/339/399 EUR, two visits, +50 per extra bedroom)

travel._comment: Fixed travel fee per TOWN and per treatment (not per bedroom). No km pricing, no Maps API, departure town deliberately not stated. Town not listed here = individual quote (never assume free travel).

whatsappQuoteNote: Calculator sends exactly the amounts it shows (js/quote.js is the only price engine).
